If you withdraw from the university today, you will receive **no refund** on your tuition [Doc: Fee Payment & Refund Policy 2026-27 §6]. 

### Supporting Details
* **Total Tuition Paid:** ₹3,21,90,000 [SQL]
* **Class Start Time:** 2026-10-26T15:00:00 [SQL]
* **Reference Date:** 23 Nov 2026 (Today)
* **Days Elapsed:** More than 30 days have elapsed since classes began. According to the refund policy, withdrawal requests received "More than 30 days after classes begin" are eligible for **No refund** [Doc: Fee Payment & Refund Policy 2026-27 §6].
sql: SELECT SUM(f.amount_paid) AS total_tuition_paid, MIN(t.start_time) AS class_start_time, CAST('2026-10-27' AS DATE) - MIN(t.start_time) AS days_elapsed FROM fee_ledger AS f JOIN students AS s ON f.student_id = s.student_id CROSS JOIN timetable AS t WHERE s.student_id = 'S2025CS001' AND f.component LIKE 'tuition_%' LIMIT 200
